== Welcome to the Turtle WoW Mage FAQ ==
Answers to the most asked questions as well as other useful information regarding the mage class on TurtleWoW can be found on the sites linked below.

The sites refer to the [https://forum.turtle-wow.org/viewtopic.php?t=15157 '''patch 1.17.2, which is after the class changes #2 (CC2)''']. The patch notes regarding mages '''[https://forum.turtle-wow.org/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102968 can be found here].''' The class, as well as the items, keep getting updated. To see the most recent set of changes, check out [https://forum.turtle-wow.org/viewforum.php?f=63 the patch notes].

For useful add-ons, check out the '''[[Addons]]''' site.

For general questions related to Mage on Turtle WoW see the [[Mage General FAQ|'''Mage General FAQ''']]

For levelling specs, and questions about levelling in general, see [[Mage Levelling FAQ|'''Mage Levelling FAQ''']]
